babs.1: Whoever chose beating, killing and humiliation over disbelief
babs.2: On the sale of one under coercion and the like, rightfully and otherwise
babs.3: Marriage under coercion is not valid
babs.4: If he is coerced into giving away or selling a slave, it is not valid
babs.5: If a woman is forced into fornication, there is no hadd upon her
babs.6: A man's oath for his companion that he is his brother when he fears he will be killed
